Intermediate screenshots; final screenshots all preserved without recompression

limits: Linux/X11/Xvfb without a window manager; no desktop-wide or docked-host qualification.
Extra host top is admitted only when QueryTree proves it is directly below root; WM reparenting may add another frame.
Raw hierarchy alone does not establish logical focus; only the observed one-shot event pair is accepted.
All observer work is GUI-thread-only and count bounded, but X server reply latency is not time bounded.
SDK diagnostic host supplies edit callbacks but does not process audio; REAPER audio was closed and direct endEdit/processor note-off were not observed.
The non-Linux compile is a preprocessor smoke check performed on Linux, not native Windows/macOS verification.
The standalone fixture log predates any later CTest registration; this archive does not claim that integration.
